Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
Our products fall into two main styles: In-Ear (Earbuds) and Over-Ear (Earmuffs).
Earbuds are lightweight, compact, and easy to wear under hats or safety gear. They seal inside your ear canal using expanding foam tips for certified noise protection.
Over-Ear Earmuffs rest over your entire ear with cushioned ear cups, making them very easy to put on and take off while providing continuous noise protection.
Many models in both styles also feature Bluetooth for music and calls, as well as Aware Technology™ to let you hear surrounding conversations while blocking loud noises.
